notes.title: First Gameplay Reveal – Kitchen Sabotage is Here!
notes.notes:
[h3]🎥 [b]Our First Gameplay Video is Live![/b][/h3][p]Chefs are hard at work in the kitchen! 🍳 But beware—among you lurk impostors determined to sabotage every dish! 👀[/p][p]We’re excited to share the very first gameplay footage of Kitchen Sabotage.
Play with 4-12 players online or over local WiFi, cook up delicious meals, and stay alert against sneaky saboteurs![/p][h3]👉 [b]Watch the video now and witness the chaos in the kitchen![/b][/h3]
